backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor implementing Callaway golf scoring with event submission/update endpoints, a hardcoded scoring chart (69-125 gross score range with deduction holes and adjustments), and calculation logic that processes raw events into ranked results.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: tie-breaking logic for leaderboard rankings (net score first, then gross score) and footer text addition ('designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC').
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files describing the React application structure, including routing, state management, Callaway calculation engine, score entry, leaderboard with tie-breaking, chart persistence with migration logic, and PDF export functionality.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer documentation explaining how to update the default Callaway scoring charts (18-hole and 9-hole), including the GridChartData structure with 13×5 grids, column adjustments [2, 1, 0, -1, -2], and placeholder cell handling.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Draft restoration marker documenting the current production state of the Callaway Scoring System application with event setup, score entry, calculation engine, leaderboard, admin chart editor, PDF export, and settings panel features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system for light and dark modes, featuring golf-themed cream/green palette and CSS custom properties for all UI components including sidebar, charts, and destructive actions.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag and title 'Callaway Golf Scoring Calculator with Pinehurst Trip Championship Leaderboard', loading the React application via main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router setup defining three routes (scoring flow at /, settings at /settings, admin at /admin) and managing a three-step scoring workflow (event setup, score entry, leaderboard calculation) with shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters, 'Designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC' text, and copyright notice with dynamic year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with tournament title, conditional 'Start Over' button (shown after step 1), settings navigation button, and admin navigation button (visible only when admin access is enabled).
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin view component that displays CallawayChartEditor when admin access is enabled, or shows a locked state card with a link to Settings when admin access is disabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: React component providing an editable UI for customizing Callaway scoring charts (9 or 18 holes) with validation, save/reset functionality, and tabbed interface for gross scores, worst holes, and adjustments.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form component for configuring tournament details including title, course name, golfer count (1-64), hole count (9 or 18), and course par with validation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Card component displaying detailed Callaway scoring breakdown for a single golfer including gross score, deduction, adjustment, net score, and hole-by-hole scores.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Card component that displays the active Callaway scoring chart in a table format showing gross score ranges, worst holes, and adjustments for the tournament's hole count.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Utility function that generates a print-optimized HTML document and triggers browser print dialog to export tournament leaderboard standings as PDF.

Exports tournament final standings to PDF by opening a new window with print-optimized HTML content including event title, course name, player rankings, and scores. Uses browser print functionality to generate the PDF with styled tables and formatting.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Table component displaying ranked tournament results with trophy/medal icons for top 3 positions, showing rank, player name, net score, gross score, deduction, and adjustment.
Main leaderboard view that calculates Callaway results from golfer data, displays standings table and breakdowns, and provides PDF export functionality for standings and leaderboard.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: React component that renders a list of golfer score entry cards, allowing input of player names and hole-by-hole scores with automatic calculation of front nine, back nine, and gross total scores. Validates numeric input and displays subtotals when all scores in a range are filled.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data by checking for required player name, correct hole count, and that all hole scores are filled with positive numbers between 1 and 15. Returns error messages for validation failures or null if valid.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Settings view component that allows users to toggle admin access on/off using a switch control. Displays current admin status and provides a back button to return to previous screen.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Automatically recreates the actor when identity changes and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Custom React hook that provides reactive admin access state by listening to localStorage changes and custom events. Updates immediately when admin access is toggled in any tab.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle. Includes status tracking for initialization, login progress, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching backend data: useGetLatestResult retrieves the most recent event result, and useGetCallawayChart fetches the scoring chart used for calculations. Both hooks depend on the actor being available.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Merriweather and Inter), configures Tailwind CSS layers, and defines a golf-themed color palette with CSS custom properties for both light mode (cream/paper) and dark mode (forest green/charcoal) themes.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Core Callaway handicap calculation logic that computes net scores by deducting worst holes based on gross score ranges from backend or grid charts, with support for fractional holes and course par rules.
Defines Callaway chart data structures (GridCell, GridChartData, CallawayChartEntry) and legacy 18-hole and 9-hole chart constants with gross ranges, worst holes, and adjustments.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages localStorage persistence for Callaway charts including active/edited charts and user-default charts, with migration detection from old shipped defaults to new 13-row grid format.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Utility functions for handling placeholder cells in Callaway chart grids where both grossScore and worstHoles are zero, including display and parsing helpers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin access state in localStorage with functions to check and set admin access enabled flag, emitting custom events for reactivity.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for event setup, golfer data with hole scores, and Callaway result data including gross, net, deduction, and chart information.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (using OKLCH), typography, container settings, animations, and design system tokens.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking two feature requests: implementing tie-breaking logic for equal net scores using gross scores, and adding a footer credit for Dancing Skeleton, LLC.
